services.desc: No Reservations Required. Stop by and experience a personal 20 minute session any time between 5:30 and 7:30p.m.! On the last Thursday of the month. Love Donation Learning Center 2770 Browning St. Sarasota, FL 34237 Time: 5:30pm-7:30pm Reiki is a Japanese healing technique that uses spiritual universal energy to assist the body to come back into balance. Rei means "universal" and Ki is "life force energy". Reiki practitioners allow the life force energy from God, Source, the Universe, to enter through their hands and into the client's body. Reiki can do no harm, it is from Love. The client's body embraces the energy and takes what it needs to heal, be that physical, spiritual or emotional.
